IC1: - Must have a clinical diagnosis of solid tumor cancer and be seeking treatment [AND] and supportive care at the UF Health Cancer Center (Medical Plaza)
IC2: - Patients must plan to receive chemotherapy known to be associated with the need for supportive care within 30 days of enrollment
IC3: - Life expectancy must be greater than 6 months
IC4: - Must have Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status of 0-2
IC5: - Written informed consent obtained from the patient
IC6: - The ability for the patient to comply with all the study-related procedures.
